findings.finding: The Nasdaq acquirer's 30-day exclusivity under the 17 Oct LOI lapsed around 16-17 Nov with no ESPI on extension or termination (ESPI 47-56/2026 cover contracts, EGM, board and series R only), while the 18 Nov EGM dropped the series S issue at >= 33 PLN, making the LOI's >= EUR 10m equity condition harder (series R raises ~20.9m PLN, ~EUR 5m); the report's subsequent-events note is the first place the status must be stated.

findings.why_not_priced: The stock at 19.40 PLN sits ~22% below the LOI floor of ~25 PLN/share (261m PLN / 10.45m shares), so the market prices a low deal probability; what it has not seen is the company's own statement of status after exclusivity ran out. A termination would normally have needed an ESPI under MAR, so silence is weakly positive, but the dropped series S cuts the other way; net slightly negative, wide range.

baseline_tension: The lean is the -19.7% 20-day run-up alone (no register); nothing found is orthogonal and strong enough to beat it: the headline is pre-released and the swing factor (LOI status) has no sourced sign, so the evidence neither agrees with nor cuts against the run-up in a sizable way.
